description: Source file implementing trust store logic for certificate trust management, including trust type checks, string conversions, and trust parsing.

classes.name: CertificateTrust
classes.description: Represents the trust status of a certificate, with methods to determine trust type and convert to/from debug strings.

classes.name: TrustStore
classes.description: Manages a collection of trusted certificates and provides asynchronous issuer retrieval.

methods.name: IsTrustAnchor
methods.description: Determines if the trust object is a trust anchor.

methods.name: IsTrustLeaf
methods.description: Checks if the trust object is a trust leaf.

methods.name: IsDistrusted
methods.description: Checks if the trust object is marked as distrusted.

methods.name: HasUnspecifiedTrust
methods.description: Checks if the trust object has unspecified trust.

methods.name: ToDebugString
methods.description: Converts the trust object to a debug string representation.

methods.name: FromDebugString
methods.description: Parses a trust string to create a trust object.

methods.name: AsyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves issuer certificates for a given certificate.
